data.action: 撑着蕾丝洋伞漫步白蔷薇园，微笑回望
data.description: 【圣园未花 · 雨中白蔷薇园的漫步】细雨轻落的圣三一庭园里，未花撑着一把蕾丝洋伞漫步在盛开的白蔷薇丛中，发丝与纯白羽翼上沾着晶莹的水珠。她转身朝你伸出手，金眸中满是依恋——「雨中的花香真好闻呢……不过只要有老师在身边，不管是晴天还是雨天，未花都觉得超幸福的☆」
data.promptProse: Mika walks among wet white roses beneath a lace parasol, extending a hand toward the teacher in a three-quarter rear medium view. Her white school dress, red ribbon and fur-edged capelet remain clear beside beaded wings. Light through a cloud gap touches the rose petals and her reaching hand, while rain-softened foliage recedes behind and small reflections gather on the path.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 雨中白蔷薇园的漫步
